reply.text:
Three hours of cardio a day is not something I'll help set up, and I'd rather not treat it as a way to lose weight faster. Burning that much to speed up weight loss is a pattern to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can look at your whole picture and tell you what's safe for you. I'm glad to help with the training side once you've done that.

In the meantime, I can build you a sustainable week of lifting and moderate cardio that fits your schedule. Tell me how many days you can train and I'll set it up.
